_comment: Verifies the developer scripts themselves. stdlib unittest only -- adding pytest as a dependency just to test a handful of helpers would be heavier than the thing being tested. The suite runs in the project environment (uv run --no-sync), where dev-secrets' cryptography is installed, so its key-material tests run instead of being skipped. The argv matches the gate's `developer scripts' own tests` step: two doors, one behaviour, so selftest cannot pass while the gate fails.
